title: Apply Config Change Result
description: Return of the apply-config-change agent: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the proposed commit subject, the files it changed, and the real task type when the task is no configuration change

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: Only a question a human must answer before the work can be trusted, phrased as a question (such as which file, key or value the task meant, or what to do about an edit that was refused or failed), or an empty string. Explanations of your choices go in notes, never here

notes.description: What you want to explain about your choices, in plain words, or an empty string. No gate reads it and it never stops the run

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line for the change

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified

retype.description: The task type this task really is when it is no configuration change (it needs new or changed tests, renames or moves code, or spans several steps), with files_changed empty and the reason in notes; pb then runs it as that type. An empty string for a configuration change
